utility.notes: The City of San Gabriel's own Utilities page states: 'SCE is responsible for electrical service connection/disconnection and/or to report power outages,' listing SCE's own contact number (800.655.4555) for electricity service.

value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: The City of San Gabriel's own Utilities page names only SCE for electric service, with no Community Choice Aggregator (e.g. Clean Power Alliance) mentioned anywhere on the page — unlike neighboring Sierra Madre, whose city site prominently describes its own CPA enrollment. Recorded as SCE directly (not a CCA) based on this absence, rather than assumed; if San Gabriel later joins a CCA this should be re-verified.

county.notes: San Gabriel's own SolarAPP+ page instructs applicants to 'Verify your address is in incorporated San Gabriel (not LA County unincorporated areas)' using an LA County service locator tool, structurally confirming the city-county relationship.

permit_url.notes: This is the City's current live SolarAPP+ page. An older 'Residential Solar Power Systems Permit Issuance Checklist' (2021, AB 2188 standard-plan-review pathway) was found and read earlier this session but has since been removed from the city's site (confirmed 404 on a live re-check before this record was finalized) and is not cited here — replaced with this current page as the sole primary source.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for the Irvine, Fullerton, and Sierra Madre records this session. sce.com returned a DNS-level failure to automated fetch; the URL is confirmed to exist under this exact title on SCE's own domain via search engine indexing.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes San Gabriel/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused here as a utility-level fact.
